definitions.explanation: Attractively bright, colorful, and impressive. Often describes appearance, events, or lifestyles that are dazzling and splendid.

examples.japanese: {華|はな}やかな⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
{華|はな}やかな⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: To stand on a glamorous stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{華|はな}やかな⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a glamorous atmosphere around her.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverb: {華|はな}やかに (gorgeously)
・Noun: {華|はな}やかさ (gorgeousness, glamour)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{華|はな}やかな⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (glamorous world)
・{華|はな}やかな⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧ (brilliant career)
・{華|はな}やかに⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (decorate gorgeously)

NUANCE: Has positive connotations of beauty and brilliance. Unlike ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧ (flashy), {華|はな}やか implies tasteful splendor rather than gaudiness.

KANJI: May also be written as {花|はな}やか, though {華|はな}やか is more common for the figurative sense.
